event.title: Mississippi AG Declares Police Shooting of 1-Year-Old Justified
event.canonical_title: Mississippi AG Declares Police Shooting of 1-Year-Old Justified
event.summary: Mississippi Attorney General has stated that the police shooting which resulted in the death of 1-year-old Kohen Wiley was justified. The incident occurred in June when officers fired at a vehicle in a Walmart parking lot, leading to the child's death and injuring a friend of his mother, who was driving the car. The officer involved has been cleared of any wrongdoing related to the shooting.
